preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in A)
preconditions.description: All elements in A must be integers.
The length of A must be between 1 and 20,000 inclusive.
A must contain all integers from 0 to N-1 without duplicates.

postconditions.description: The return value must be an integer.
The return value must be between 1 and the length of A inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(A[i] for i in range(len(A)) if i in visited)) == len(visited) for visited in [{i} for i in range(len(A))])
postconditions.description: Each set S[i] must not contain duplicate elements.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(len(visited) for visited in [{i} for i in range(len(A))])
postconditions.description: The return value must be the length of the longest set S[i].
